name: Before and After Comparator
description: A full-surface comparison slider with a crisp divider and keyboard control, shown with an original typographic wireframe and finished editorial cover.

props.name: before
props.description: Decorative visual layer. Hidden from the accessibility tree; nested controls are excluded from keyboard navigation.

props.name: after
props.description: Decorative visual layer. Hidden from the accessibility tree; nested controls are excluded from keyboard navigation.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled whole-percentage split, rounded and clamped to 0-100. Non-finite values use 50. A controlled comparison without onChange is read-only.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial local percentage, rounded and clamped to 0-100. Non-finite values use 50.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.
